message.content:
Your cart is currently empty, and I don't have access to past order history in this system — I can only view active carts and process new checkouts.

To display an invoice, I would need one of the following:
1. **The order details** (products, shipping address, payment info) so I can add the items back and generate a fresh checkout/invoice, or
2. **An order confirmation ID** — though note this tool set doesn't include an "order lookup" function, so I can't retrieve past orders directly.

Could you share the book titles/product IDs from your order along with your shipping address and payment info? I'll be happy to recreate the order summary for you.
